subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about running {Brand} on a pure cost-per-sale basis across your web ordering journeys. The one point worth repeating: you pay per validated completed order with a unique order ID and revenue that survives the returns window, never per click or checkout-start, the same affiliate model DoorDash runs for new customers. We work to a daily throughput near 5,000 validated orders. If it helps, I can share the metro-level validated-order view. Worth a short look?
angle: warm bump, restate validated completed-order proof
illustrative_flags: 5,000 validated orders a day (daily completed-order volume; MobUpps-specific illustrative placeholder, not an established result)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN food_and_delivery CPS: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (pay per validated completed order, order ID, returns window survives); one illustrative MobUpps figure (5,000 validated orders/day, flagged); peer DoorDash reused from parent, no new brand; soft CTA, 1 question mark; no sign-off, no em-dash, no X-not-Y.
